actions.action: Condense only verified, license-equivalent exact duplicates
actions.mechanism: Matching file hashes establish duplicate candidates; verified license equivalence gates condensation, while distinct licensing remains visible.
actions.implementation: Precompute groups using hashes, dimensions, and verified license identity. Keep unknown licenses separate; expose member paths, creators, and an expand control.
actions.check: Identical pixels with different license records remain separate results. Same-hash, license-equivalent copies expand to every original file.
actions.risk: Overly broad license equivalence could conceal distinct entitlements.

actions.action: Record variant relationships without collapsing their results
actions.mechanism: Explicit relationships organize crops and annotations without treating visual resemblance as permission to hide files.
actions.implementation: Let people link asset IDs with typed relationships: crop-of, annotated-from, or alternate-version-of. Display related assets while preserving independent search entries.
actions.check: Link two different crops to one original; confirm all three remain individually searchable and relationship changes never modify files.
actions.risk: Mistaken relationships require editable labels and recorded authorship.

actions.action: Record the exact licensed file each project used
actions.mechanism: Project usage records preserve file identity and licensing context independently of search grouping or later metadata changes.
actions.implementation: On asset selection, record project ID, member asset ID, hash, path, and license record revision or snapshot; require member selection within groups.
actions.check: Select identically rendered files with different licenses into separate projects; each project must resolve its chosen file and historical license.
actions.risk: Existing projects without usage records need explicit reconciliation.

actions.action: Make condensed results explain their query matches
actions.mechanism: Query-aware representatives prevent duplicate grouping from obscuring matching folder paths, creators, or other member-specific metadata.
actions.implementation: Apply search filters before grouping; choose a matching member as representative. Show matching-member counts and distinguish other copies when expanded.
actions.check: Search a creator or folder belonging only to a nondefault member; its group must appear and identify that matching file.
actions.risk: Unlabeled counts could imply every member matches the query.

actions.action: Keep grouping work off the first-page request
actions.mechanism: Precomputed group fields and bounded result payloads avoid request-time file inspection and full-family expansion.
actions.implementation: Add group IDs and summary counts to the existing index. Fetch member details on expansion; measure the complete first-page load.
actions.check: Benchmark broad, filtered, and crop searches across all 12,000 assets under documented load and cache conditions; each first page must load under one second.
actions.risk: Index updates can temporarily leave group summaries stale.

actions.action: Let users protect intentionally separate search entries
actions.mechanism: An explicit keep-separate override protects workflows where even identical, license-equivalent files have distinct organizational meaning.
actions.implementation: Store a reversible asset-level grouping exclusion with author and reason. Offer an uncondensed search view; neither control changes files or licensing.
actions.check: Exclude one member of a duplicate group; it appears independently. Undo the exclusion and verify regrouping preserves project usage records.
actions.risk: Excessive exclusions can restore clutter; show their reasons.
